claim: Google's Gemini environmental paper is important less for a single universal number than because it reports production per-prompt energy, emissions, and water while explicitly excluding training and storage from scope.
shortLabel: Provider metrics still depend on scope
displayValue: Production metrics are still scoped metrics
comparisonContext: This is the clearest way to teach why one provider's prompt number cannot simply be generalized to all AI use.
scopeNote: The paper is explicit that it covers inference and serving rather than full lifecycle analysis.
sourceTitle: Measuring the environmental impact of delivering AI at Google Scale
